items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
items.claim: The text says that after Moses stretched his rod over Egypt, the LORD brought an east wind for a full day and night, and by morning the wind had brought the locusts. This is what the narrative says, not a verified historical event. Labeling the verse as Exodus 10:13 comes from model-prior (only '10:13' is in the document) and is unverified.
items.action: stretched forth his rod; brought an east wind that carried locusts
items.mechanism: An east wind blowing all day and all night carried the locusts into the land
